title: Git plugin GDExtension fails to load when using Reload Current Project due to Windows file locking limitations
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable, 4.5.dev4

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7640) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads)g

### Issue description

Git plugin GDExtension fails to load when using **Project > Reload Current Project** due to Windows file locking limitations. This is not an issue when starting the editor through other means; only *restarting* the editor immediately after it's been shut down causes this issue.

It will load successfully if you repeat the operation, as the Git extension will have failed to load, which means no version control plugins are loaded for the current session. In practice, this means it'll work every other time you use **Project > Reload Current Project**.

The log gives us the full story (note that it's not printed to the editor Output panel, you need to start Godot from a terminal to see everything):

```
Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build.452104d47 (2025-06-02 16:42:55 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.303 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090

Found a repository at C:/Users/Hugo/Documents/t3/.git/.
Selected repository path: C:/Users/Hugo/Documents/t3/.git/.
ERROR: Failed to open 'C:/Users/Hugo/Documents/t3/addons/godot-git-plugin/windows/~libgit_plugin.windows.editor.x86_64.dll'.
   at: (core\io\dir_access.cpp:423)
ERROR: Error copying library: C:/Users/Hugo/Documents/t3/addons/godot-git-plugin/windows/libgit_plugin.windows.editor.x86_64.dll
   at: OS_Windows::open_dynamic_library (platform\windows\os_windows.cpp:491)
ERROR: Can't open GDExtension dynamic library: 'res://addons/godot-git-plugin/git_plugin.gdextension'.
   at: (core\extension\gdextension.cpp:707)
ERROR: Error loading extension: 'res://addons/godot-git-plugin/git_plugin.gdextension'.
   at: (core\extension\gdextension_manager.cpp:291)
Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build.452104d47 (2025-06-02 16:42:55 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.303 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090

ERROR: Cannot get class 'GitPlugin'.
   at: (core\object\class_db.cpp:546)
ERROR: Received a nullptr VCS extension instance during construction.
   at: (editor\plugins\version_control_editor_plugin.cpp:151)
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Set up https://github.com/godotengine/godot-git-plugin in a project.
- Open the editor from a terminal, then use **Project > Reload Current Project**.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_git_plugin.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20575856/test_git_plugin.zip)
